question: What is WAWTECH?
answer:
WAWTECH is a major tech conference taking place in November 2026, bringing together thousands of IT professionals, engineers, founders, product leaders, and tech enthusiasts from Poland and across Europe.

The event will feature speakers from leading global tech companies such as Google, Netflix, Agoda, Writer, Superhuman, and more.

Our mission is to highlight the incredible talent in Central and Eastern Europe, showcase world-class products built here, and position Warsaw as one of Europe’s thriving tech hubs.

question: When and where will WAWTECH take place?
answer:
WAWTECH 2026 will take place on November 26–27, 2026, in Warsaw, Poland.

The venue is EXPO XXI Warsaw, located at 12/14 Prądzyńskiego Street, just a short distance from the city center and easily accessible by public transport.

question: What types of tickets are available and how much do they cost?
answer:
All details about ticket types, pricing, and price changes are available in the Tickets section of our website.

Our pricing is tiered by quantity, not by date — once a certain number of tickets in one pricing wave sells out, the next pricing tier begins. That’s why purchasing early usually means getting the best available price.

We offer three ticket types: Regular, PRO, and MAX.

All ticket types provide access to both days of WAWTECH, with additional benefits depending on the ticket category.

question: Which days does my ticket cover? Do I need separate tickets for each day?
answer:
Any WAWTECH ticket gives you access to both days of the conference — November 26 and 27.

There is no need to purchase separate tickets for each day.

Please note that one-day tickets are not available.

question: Are there student or group discounts?
answer:
Yes! We offer a special Student ticket for 199 PLN for attendees under 21 years old. Please note that ID will be checked at the entrance.

For group discounts, contact us at hello@wawtech.io , and we'll be happy to discuss a special offer for your team or group.

question: Can I get a refund after purchasing my ticket?
answer:
You can request a full refund within 14 days of purchasing your ticket.

However, all refunds close 14 days before the conference, regardless of the ticket purchase date. If your individual 14-day refund period would normally extend beyond this deadline, it will automatically end 14 days before the event.

After this deadline, no refunds will be issued.

question: Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?
answer:
Yes.

Once the 14-day refund period after your purchase has ended, you can transfer your ticket to another attendee.

Use the Transfer option in your personal account to change the attendee details.

You’ll find the link to your personal account in the confirmation email sent after your purchase. If you can’t find it, please check your Spam folder.

Please note that once a ticket has been transferred to another person, the transfer cannot be reversed and the original holder cannot reclaim the ticket.

question: Are tickets personalized? Do I need to show an ID at the entrance?
answer:
Yes. WAWTECH tickets are personalized.

You’ll need to present a valid ID matching the name on your ticket during registration at the venue.

question: Can I purchase a ticket as a company and receive an invoice?
answer:
Yes.

When purchasing your ticket, select the “Buy as a company” checkbox and enter your company details.

Once the payment is completed, an invoice will be generated automatically and sent to the email address provided during checkout.

question: Can I upgrade my ticket to a higher category?
answer:
Ticket upgrades are not available yet.

We plan to make the upgrade option available later. We’ll announce it once the feature is open.

question: Is there an option to join WAWTECH online?
answer:
No.

WAWTECH is an in-person event, and there will be no live online stream.

We believe that meeting people, exchanging ideas, networking, and experiencing the event together are an important part of WAWTECH.

question: Will the talks be recorded? How can I access them?
answer:
Yes, talks from the main conference program will be recorded.

PRO and MAX ticket holders will receive exclusive access to the recordings after the conference.

Selected talks may also be published on our YouTube channel during the year and made available publicly.

Please note that some special sessions, including the PRO Stage program, will not be recorded.

question: When will the full agenda and speaker lineup be published?
answer:
We’re continuously working on the program and announcing new speakers.

By approximately November 10–15, we expect around 90% of the WAWTECH 2026 agenda to be finalized and published.

The remaining part of the schedule may still change closer to the conference due to circumstances beyond our control.

All major program updates will also be shared with registered attendees.

question: What language will the talks be in?
answer:
The main language of WAWTECH is English.

Some sessions may also be held in Polish or Ukrainian.

The language of each individual session will be clearly indicated in the agenda.

question: What is the PRO Stage?
answer:
The PRO Stage is a separate, closed stage available exclusively to PRO and MAX ticket holders.

It is designed for more candid, in-depth conversations about the most relevant topics in technology and the industry.

The program will include discussions, panels, and conversations with prominent engineers, founders, executives, experts, and other industry leaders.

Unlike the main conference stages, PRO Stage sessions will not be recorded, creating space for more open and direct conversations.

question: Do you provide media accreditation for WAWTECH?
answer:
Yes.

Journalists, editors, bloggers, podcasters, YouTubers, and industry creators who plan to cover WAWTECH can apply for free media accreditation.

Approved applicants receive a Media Badge with access equivalent to a MAX Ticket.

Applications are accepted until November 5, 2026.

Submit your accreditation request here.

question: How can my company become a conference partner?
answer:
If your company is interested in partnership opportunities, please contact us at hello@wawtech.io.

We’ll provide information about available partnership packages and ways to showcase your company and brand at WAWTECH 2026.

question: How can a startup join the Startup Expo?
answer:
If you’d like to showcase your startup at WAWTECH 2026, contact us at hello@wawtech.io.

We’ll share information about available participation options and next steps.

question: Can I become a WAWTECH speaker?
answer: Speaker applications for WAWTECH 2026 are currently closed.

question: How can I volunteer at WAWTECH?
answer:
We are currently accepting applications from volunteers who would like to join the WAWTECH 2026 team and help us run the conference.

Apply here.

question: Will there be food available at the venue?
answer:
Yes.

There will be a food court at the venue offering a variety of meals and drinks throughout both days of the conference. Food and drinks will be available for purchase at your own expense.

Free drinking water stations will also be available, so feel free to bring your own reusable bottle.

Additionally, MAX ticket holders will have access to complimentary snacks and drinks in the MAX Lounge throughout the conference.

question: Is parking available at EXPO XXI?
answer:
Yes.

Paid parking is available near EXPO XXI for attendees of all ticket types.

Please note that the number of parking spaces is limited, so availability cannot be guaranteed. Spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

We recommend using public transport whenever possible.

question: Will there be a cloakroom or luggage storage?
answer:
Yes.

There will be a cloakroom and lockers where you can leave your outerwear and luggage during the conference.

Please do not leave valuables unattended. The organizers are not responsible for lost or stolen personal belongings.

question: Will there be rest areas or lounges?
answer:
Yes.

Several rest and chill-out areas will be available throughout the venue where you can relax, work, meet other attendees, or take a break from the conference program.

In addition, MAX ticket holders will have access to the exclusive MAX Lounge with complimentary snacks and drinks.

question: Will there be a mobile app or chat for attendees?
answer:
Yes.

You can already join the official WAWTECH 2026 WhatsApp community to connect with other attendees and receive useful updates: join here.

We will also release a dedicated WAWTECH app for attendees soon, making it easier to follow the agenda, navigate the conference, and stay connected during the event.

question: Can I bring my dog to WAWTECH?
answer:
Yes. WAWTECH is pet-friendly.

You’re welcome to bring your dog with you, but dogs must remain on a leash at all times while inside the venue.

question: Are there accessibility options for attendees with disabilities?
answer:
Yes.

EXPO XXI is accessible to attendees with disabilities.

If you need additional assistance at the venue or have specific accessibility requirements, please contact us in advance at hello@wawtech.io, and our team will do its best to assist you.
